title: Review-gated verbatim clinical evidence annotation v1.1
description: One claim. Unknown fields are explicitly null. Code-point offsets are zero-based and half-open in the indexed source section. The Python validator additionally enforces source role/hash/URL/offset equality, exact source-title ingredient identity, annotation anchors, range ordering and human source-review gates. Schema validation alone never certifies medical truth or provenance.

claim_text.description: Must exactly equal source.excerpt. No inferred paraphrase or medical answer.

url.description: Must exactly equal the saved NatMed professional-monograph source URL.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of complete saved record.text encoded as UTF-8, not excerpt hash.

name.description: Exact saved source title, not a broader mapped topic; Fish Oil is not all Omega-3 and one organism is not all probiotics.

formulation.description: Exact source-supported preparation/salt/extract; unknown is null, not interchangeable.

strain.description: Exact source-supported strain identifier; species or broad topic does not imply a strain.

population.description: Exact source-supported population; unknown is null.

indication.description: Exact source condition/use heading or explicit indication phrase, not an inferred diagnosis.

effectiveness_rating.description: Exact active publisher effectiveness heading, including negative or insufficient-evidence categories; never an evidence grade.

safety_rating.description: Exact publisher safety rating with the source population and qualifications retained in the excerpt.

adverse_effect_category.description: Exact source category heading for described adverse effects, not a heading-only inferred event.

text.description: Verbatim dose statement retaining qualifiers, alternatives and clinical context, including when normalization is unresolved.

qualifier.description: Exact dose bound such as up to or upper intake limit; a bound must not silently become an exact recommended dose.

regimen.description: Exact source regimen/role phrase, such as loading dose, maintenance dose or recommended dietary allowance.

unit.description: Exact unit text without conversion; quantity and unit must be jointly known or jointly null.

frequency.description: Exact source frequency phrase; unknown is null.

qualifier.description: Exact duration bound such as up to, not an inferred fixed treatment duration.

evidence_grade.description: Exact publisher grade text anchored in the excerpt, not an invented or translated evidence rating.

rating.description: Exact value following Interaction Rating, kept separate from Severity.

occurrence.description: Exact publisher Occurrence value, not an inferred probability.

severity.description: Exact publisher severity text, not an inferred category or an interaction rating substituted for severity.

field_support.description: Keys are dotted annotation paths, for example dose.value, ingredient.strain, dose.duration.unit. Exactly the non-null annotations except ingredient.name require anchors, all within source.excerpt and into the same source section, except an effectiveness_rating that may anchor on its publisher group heading earlier in the same section when the indication is inside the excerpt. Values must match the anchored text exactly; numeric text may differ only in decimal representation.
